$comment: One record of the hash-chained, append-only revocation log (task P2.1, C07, F07): a sidecar outside every artifact, so revoking changes no artifact bytes. The log is JSON Lines, one canonical record per line ending in a newline. Line 1 is the genesis record (seq 0, prev_sha256 all zeros, $defs/genesis); every later line is an event (this schema) whose prev_sha256 is the canonical SHA-256 of the line before. The custodian appends and writes a separate head (revocation_head.json); contracts/revocation.py verifies chain and head together, so an empty, truncated or edited log is refused, never read as 'nothing revoked'.

subject.$comment: what is revoked: an artifact (file SHA-256), a release (release_id or manifest digest), a recipe (canonical or file SHA-256), a source snapshot (snapshot_id or SHA-256) or an attestation (attestation_id or revocation_ref); at least one of ref and sha256
